status: completed TRAIN-only deterministic-path geometry experiment; no neural training or generated-quality claim
coverage: First fixed32 protein and32 complex TRAIN systems from seed71 mixture; same clips for three paths; H4/H8, immediate andlast queries, flow times0.25/0.5/0.75;2304 path states
interpretation: On this fixed TRAIN subset, even clean straight coordinate interpolation creates short-distance overlaps and shortened bonds; actual learned source perturbation and bridge noise were not included.
Removing whole-component rotation has almost no average effect; global alignment alone is not a supported remedy for these path distortions.

Independent chemical-unit rotation reduces within-block distortions and close pairs, but more than doubles mean cross-block bond error in both domains. Do NOT switch the training bridge to this naive block path.

This supports keeping inter-unit covalent connectivity in the architecture/path design. RF2 transports rotational features while retaining coupled atom layers; it does not enforce independent rigid coordinate blocks.

Large intermediate neural features and LayerNorm overflow were observed on a separate exact failed batch. These aggregate path measurements do not prove path crowding is the sole cause of that failure or the model's overall quality gap.

next_design_not_implemented.priority: Complete matched CF1/RF2 geometry, motion, full-path and clock evaluations before combining modules
next_design_not_implemented.curved_interpolant: A nonlinear endpoint-preserving Cartesian interpolant is compatible in principle with the stochastic-interpolant objective, but both training state and deterministic derivative targets must change together. In the owned PVB objective, replace target-source by dI/dflow_time in BOTH velocity and drift targets, retaining the explicitly declared stabilized gamma rule and SDE diffusion. Do not change just the noisy state or just inference noise.
next_design_not_implemented.required_geometry: Couple neighboring chemical units across covalent bonds; retain internal torsions, ligand flexibility, chirality and ring closure rather than independently rotating whole residues or treating all ligands as rigid.
next_design_not_implemented.source_gradient: An endpoint-dependent rotation fit or projection must have declared stable derivatives with respect to the learned source. Silently detaching that fit or substituting an inference-only sampler is not equivalent end-to-end source training.
next_design_not_implemented.scope: Design only. No new interpolant training run, torsion architecture, structured SDE covariance or altered reference model has been implemented.

limitations: Descriptive TRAIN subset, not an independent evaluation; unique pairs below1A include bonded pairs and are not a complete VDW metric; no kinetic/thermodynamic or causal generative-quality conclusion
